SELECT dl.id AS id, dl.created_at AS dtsCreated, p.code AS process, dl.id_product AS idProduct, a.account_id AS account, CASE WHEN dl.product_type = 'MAIN' THEN dl.description_main ELSE dl.description_sub END AS description, dc.remark AS remark, dl.source_percent AS percent, UPPER(c.code) AS currency, dl.rate_expression AS rate, CASE WHEN dl.processed_amount >= 0 THEN dl.processed_amount ELSE NULL END AS cr, CASE WHEN dl.processed_amount < 0 THEN ABS(dl.processed_amount) ELSE NULL END AS dr, dc.created_by AS createdBy, FALSE AS deleted, NULL AS deletedBy, NULL AS deletedAt FROM data_capture_line dl INNER JOIN data_captures dc ON dc.id = dl.capture_id AND dc.tenant_id = dl.tenant_id INNER JOIN process p ON p.id = dc.process_id INNER JOIN currency c ON c.id = dl.currency_id AND c.tenant_id = dl.tenant_id INNER JOIN account a ON a.id = dl.account_id WHERE dl.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dc.capture_date >= #{dateFrom} AND dc.capture_date <= #{dateTo} AND dc.category = #{category}
AND (UPPER(p.code) = UPPER(#{process}) OR CAST(p.id AS CHAR) = #{process})
